hints.title: Subsequence Preservation Constraint
hints.text: We want to maximize the count of removable indices chosen while ensuring pattern remains a valid subsequence.

hints.title: Dynamic Programming Transitions
hints.text: Let dp[j] be the maximum removals possible having matched pattern[0..j-1]. For each character in source, if removable, cost is 1 else 0.

hints.title: Reverse Array Optimization
hints.text: When source[i] == pattern[j - 1], choose between keeping source[i] to advance match (dp[j - 1]) or discarding/skipping it (dp[j] + cost).

hints.title: Reference Implementation

complexity.notes: 1D DP array of size m + 1 updated across n characters in O(n * m) time.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Greedy matching choices may consume characters needed later, leading to suboptimal removal totals.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: O(m) memory using reverse space-optimized DP array.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Applies DP sequence alignment with binary removal cost accumulation.
